limits: No parental samples: a large deletion on one allele cannot be excluded
No functional assay on this proband's cells
ClinVar and Exomiser are interpretations, not observations
mechanism_hypothesis: Loss of function by misfolding: F508del-CFTR fails NBD1 folding, is retained in the endoplasmic reticulum and degraded, so little channel reaches the apical membrane, and the residual protein that does has reduced open probability [vep:7:117559590:ATCT:A] [pmid:42616613]. A hypomorphic, folding-defective allele rather than a null.
phase_statement: Homozygous genotype (1/1, AD 0,41): both alleles carry the deletion, so phase is not in question [vep:7:117559590:ATCT:A]; a deletion of the other allele masquerading as homozygosity cannot be excluded without parental samples or coverage analysis.

criteria.justification: Functional and biochemical characterisation shows F508del-CFTR is a folding and gating defect rescued by corrector/potentiator combinations [pmid:42616613]
af 0.0119 with 58 homozygotes: not absent; consistent with a common recessive allele
In-frame deletion of one residue (Phe508) in the NBD1 domain, a non-repeat region
CF phenotype terms (HP:0002205, HP:0006528, HP:0012236); Exomiser rank 1 under AR
In-frame deletion in a conserved domain; SpliceAI 0

variants.summary: Homozygous p.Phe508del, the commonest CF allele [vep:7:117559590:ATCT:A] [clinvar:VCV000007105]; 58 homozygotes in gnomAD reflect the carrier frequency of a recessive disease, not benignity [gnomad:7-117559590-ATCT-A].

what_would_change_the_call: Parental genotypes or a coverage-based deletion call over CFTR
